title: Youth non-employment across Dutch municipalities
outcome_period: 2024 provisional figures used in the original analysis
definition: Young residents without paid work divided by all residents aged15 to under27, multiplied by100.
sources: CBS youth labour-market table86223NED, original saved extract
caveats: Non-employment includes people outside the labour force and students without paid work.
Source counts are rounded to the nearest100. Small-area ratios are particularly imprecise.
This is a historical study snapshot, not current labour-market data.

reported_sensitivity.coefficient_unit: Percentage points of youth non-employment per one-percentage-point increase in age-group share, conditional on model covariates
reported_sensitivity.note: Sensitivity values are reported estimates from the original appendix, not a new fitted model. No unreported confidence interval is inferred.
